rationale: The Latin anchors *transcribere*, *describere*, and *conscribere* all point to the act of writing/recording an account, and the phrase *cuncta per ordinem transcribere curavi* ("I took care to transcribe everything in order") strongly suggests a sense of rendering or setting down an account in writing rather than merely giving a verbal description. WordNet's `report.v.01` ("to give an account or representation of in words") best captures this sense of written narration/recording, fitting the scribal/textual context of the Old English attestations.
